name: 14585-sharegpt-8b-2gpu-pp2
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 -- two GPUs of one a3 node, ONE node.
parallelism: PP=2, TP=1, DP=1, Ray executor, V1 engine. At this engine version V1 pipeline parallelism exists only on the Ray executor, and V1 itself is selected by VLLM_USE_V1=1 (carried in configs/tuned.yaml).
load_profile: poisson (OPEN loop), rate = 2.0 req/s, bounded at 600 requests / 900 s safety, first 10% warmup and last 10% cooldown by completion. The rate is declared, not a starting point to search.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, prefix caching off. ShareGPT-SHAPED, not ShareGPT: prompt 213 tokens (stdev 235, 4..933), output 218 (stdev 211, 4..780). Two divergences worth knowing: guidellm samples a clamped Gaussian rather than the data's right-skewed shape, and the backend sets `ignore_eos`, so every generation runs to its full sampled length. The chat template puts about a dozen tokens more on the wire than the declared prompt length (+11 on this tokenizer).
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant on an eight-billion-parameter model, serving two conversational turns per second across two GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM 0.7.3-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM.
# VLLM_USE_V1=1 is not a serve argument -- it is an environment variable, in configs/tuned.yaml.
model: unsloth/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
pipeline-parallel-size: 2
distributed-executor-backend: ray
max-model-len: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: false
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
